text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected on /v1/stream (us-west). p95 420ms (norm 120ms), p99 1.8s (SLO 750ms). Streaming stalls and retries observed. Paging alex_oncall :rotating_light:

alex_oncall: on it. Any quick dashboard links or symptoms?

maya_sre: dashboards show auth 429s increasing ~6x, control-plane config-fetch latency up ~3x. token-store write wait and conn-pool queueing on a couple of replicas. link: https://grafana.redwood/inference/p99-spike

ryan_runtime: runtime reports high KV cache miss rate causing prefix reloads. continuous-batching queues lengthening -> tail latency. Logs show repeated kv-fetches.

sophia_db: DB: replica cpus 2.1x, conn_wait spikes on replicas B/C. No IO errors. Some replicas hit max connections due to burst from edge proxies.

alex_oncall: hypothesis: edge retry storm → lots of token lookups → token-store pool saturation → auth/config slow → streaming stalls → p99 spike. Need immediate mitigations: reduce auth pressure, enable cached token fallback, debounce config-fetch.

maya_sre: rolling mitigations: (1) bump token-store replicas/pool on affected nodes (replicas 6->8), (2) flip feature flag inference.edge.auth_allow_cached_tokens=true, (3) widen internal auth rate-limit windows temporarily. Who can flip the flag?

ryan_runtime: I can. PATCH /flags/inference.edge.auth_allow_cached_tokens true now.

incident-bot: Deploy comment recorded by ryan_runtime at 2425551260.

ryan_runtime: flag is on. Observing KV-miss rate.

maya_sre: scaling token-store pool: DEPLOY token-store group canary -> replicas increased on dedicated nodes. Triggered shard expansion.

sophia_db: confirmed pool increase on replicas; conn wait dropping.

lee_support: impact on customers? Need early comms.

jordan_product: two PLG customers reported degraded streaming in last 15m. No enterprise escalations yet. Recommend partial-status page update.

alex_oncall: drafting status page: include p95/p99, endpoints, mitigations, ETA.

maya_sre: after flag + pool bump: auth 429s decreasing, KV-miss down ~45%, p95 ~210ms, p99 trending ~920ms. Improving but still >SLO.

ryan_runtime: worker logs show fewer prefix cache reloads. sample logs:

```
2026-03-15T12:07:21Z worker-12 INFO prefix_cache miss key=org:12345:conv:678 ttl=0.032
2026-03-15T12:07:22Z worker-12 DEBUG replaying kv-fetch for prefix, latency=0.78s
```

maya_sre: next quick action: push jittered backoff on edge proxies for streaming clients that receive retry-after so they don't immediate-retry. Will push policy.

sophia_db: also seeing noisy feature-flag toggles from a small client cohort increasing config-fetch QPS. Pushed short-lived debounce in control plane to smooth eval calls.

lee_support: affected customers list: customer_alpha (PLG), beta-saas (trial), gamma-enterprise (single request). Severity P2 — user-facing slowdown. Account reps notified for alpha and beta.

alex_oncall: timeline draft:
- 12:05 UTC: incident-bot detects p99 spike.
- 12:06 UTC: auth 429s spike; token-store conn queue begins to rise.
- 12:08 UTC: KV cache miss rate increases; streaming queues back up.
- 12:10 UTC: flag flip + token-store pool bump initiated.
- 12:13 UTC: partial mitigation; p95/p99 improving.

ryan_runtime: tracing shows slow segments in token-store and config-fetch flows. Root cause combination: (A) client retry storm from subset (bad retry behaviour), (B) token-store pool exhaustion on some replicas, (C) noisy feature-flag toggles causing extra config-fetches. Cascading effect created tail stalls.

alex_oncall: action items:
- maya_sre: follow up on token-store autoscale thresholds, add circuit-breaker for auth write path.
- ryan_runtime: ship edge-proxy default jittered backoff and client guidance.
- sophia_db: add alert for token-store conn-wait >100ms per replica.
- lee_support: confirm customer notifications and collect request logs.

maya_sre: creating incident doc /incidents/246-inference-edge-auth-cache-fallthrough (RCA will live there).

jordan_product: recommend outreach to the two impacted PLG customers tomorrow to offer assistance and discuss SLA if needed.

lee_support: received logs from customer_alpha, forwarding to eng for deeper triage.

alex_oncall: will escalate to PD if p99 >= 750ms after 20m. Current p99 880ms.

maya_sre: if strain persists we'll consider controlplane.config_cache_fallthrough=true to let serving use last-known-good configs (degrades feature-flag freshness but preserves streaming). We'll only enable as last resort.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-7891 created by alex_oncall.

(18m later)

maya_sre: update: p95 150ms, p99 600ms. token-store conn_wait <30ms. Keeping auth_allow_cached_tokens on for now.

ryan_runtime: reverting client docs to recommend backoff; scheduling per-customer throttles and long-term rate-limit improvements.

alex_oncall: leaving flag on for monitoring window. No config_cache_fallthrough flip — prefer to avoid unless necessary.

jordan_product: agree, prefer not to enable fallthrough.

lee_support: customers updated; postmortem promised.

maya_sre: status -> mitigated; starting RCA draft. Long-term actions: debounce feature-flag evals, auth rate-limit windows, token-store autoscaling and circuit-breakers, edge backoff defaults, per-customer throttles.

alex_oncall: handing off to oncall-maya in 1 hour. Closing active page for now :thumbsup:
